next.reason: 1985: the values of data-name-1, data-name-3 and data-name-4 'at the time an OPEN statement with the OUTPUT phrase is executed' size the first logical page, and their values 'at the time a WRITE statement with the ADVANCING PAGE phrase is executed or a page overflow condition occurs' size the next. §2023:13.18.34.4 GR6 b) takes the data item's content 'At the completion of an OPEN statement with the OUTPUT phrase', during a WRITE with ADVANCING PAGE, and during a WRITE that causes page overflow, and 'the value applies to the next logical page'. The added 'before the device is positioned and after all positioning on the current page' fixes the same instant 1985 names. The EC-I-O-LINAGE check in that rule carries 1985 GR2/GR3's value limits, not this timing rule. Same meaning.
